title: On Immigration, Progressives are ‘American Exceptionalists’
author: Muzainy Shahiefisally
content:
![On Immigration, Progressives are ‘American
Exceptionalists’](https://www.compactmag.com/content/images/2026/02/AP26031012240253.jpg)

Progressives in the United States tend to be hostile to "American
exceptionalism," which they regard as tantamount to the chauvinism they
deplore in President Trump and his MAGA agenda. Yet in many of their
criticisms of Trump's policies, it is progressives who are "exceptionalists,"
holding the United States to entirely different standards than the rest of the
world. By contrast, much of Trump's agenda looks quite normal by global
standards.

Nowhere is this reversal clearer than on immigration policy. If we believe the
progressive [_mainstream media_]() or many liberal
[_politicians_](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cf6c23Rrw_4&t=26&ref=compactmag.com),
Trump's immigration policy is a display of unparalleled cruelty. But despite
their cosmopolitan pretenses, those convinced of this seem to have little
interest in how immigration is handled in other countries. When we compare
current US policies on illegal immigration to those of other nations, rather
than those of the Biden administration, Trump's approach looks unexceptional.
